summary: Master Jira for remote project management with our expert-led training course. Gain essential skills to optimize your projects and improve team efficiency.
lede: Jira-based remote project management helps project managers and team contributors coordinate work across remote or hybrid teams. The course covers structuring projects and issues, designing boards and workflows that clarify ownership, and using backlogs, sprint tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor progress, risks, and blockers. Participants practice communicating status and keeping teams aligned through Jira comments, mentions, and notifications.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who manage or contribute to projects in remote or hybrid environments.
audience: Scrum Masters and Agile team leads
Anyone using Jira to manage work
modules: Jira and the Reality of Remote Project Management
Understanding Jira Projects, Issues, and Boards
Designing Effective Jira Boards for Remote Teams
Backlog and Task Management Across Time Zones
Sprint Planning and Delivery in Remote Teams
Governance, Best Practices, and Continuous Improvement
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of project management concepts and familiarity with remote work tools. Access to a Jira account is recommended for hands-on exercises.
